title: Routes

commands.report: 135 unit tests pass; routes/settings suites cover priority, quiet inheritance, validation, binding ambiguity and settings concurrency

tests: resolution priority session > agent > workspace > global > settings for destinations and quiet independently
an empty destination array is an explicit stop and does not fall back to settings
saveRoute enforces scope/scopeId, declared destinations and uniqueness
route update requires expectedRevision and rejects both-null fields
session binding prefers an explicit binding, otherwise a single authorized session, and refuses ambiguity
settings.revision is a separate optimistic counter
activityRetentionDays is bounded and non-writable fields are rejected
